title: squarespace.get_product
description: Input/output contract for retrieving a single product by id. GET /products/{id} on the commerce base URL (https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce). This is an 8th action, added beyond the 5 originally scoped in connector.yaml plus list_contacts and get_order, once those seven were complete. VERIFICATION STATUS: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-19, against a real product id (6a82c75d452f993158f1ae4b) — see fixtures/product-by-id.json for the untrimmed capture. This DISPROVES the endpoint's earlier assumption (modeled as a flat object, by analogy to create_order's confirmed flat response). The real shape is `{ products: [ {...} ] }` — the SAME top-level `products` array key list_products uses for its collection response, here holding a single-item array for a valid id. It is also NOT `{ product: {...} }`, the singular-key wrap get_contact's GET-by-id turned out to use — so this is a third distinct envelope pattern across this connector's three GET-by-id-style endpoints (get_contact: wrapped singular key; create_order: flat; get_product: wrapped plural key, no pagination). Also notable: unlike list_products, this response has NO `pagination` key at all — confirmed absent on the one real capture, not merely unconfirmed. What remains UNCONFIRMED: whether the array can ever legitimately hold zero or more than one item (e.g. for a nonexistent id — a 404 vs an empty `products` array was not itself tested), and whether get_order's analogous endpoint follows this same wrapped-plural-key pattern (get_order has not yet been called live against a real order id — see get-order.schema.json).

input.title: GetProductInput
input.description: Retrieval is by product id, appended to the commerce base as GET /products/{id}. CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-19: this path is real and reachable, and returns a 200 with a matching product for a valid id.

id.description: Product identifier, e.g. the `id` field on a list_products response (real observed ids look like "6a82c75d452f993158f1ae4b"). No format is enforced beyond non-empty.

output.title: GetProductResult
output.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-19 — wrapped in the same top-level `products` array key as list_products, holding a single-item array for a valid id, with no `pagination` key. See this schema's top-level VERIFICATION STATUS.

products.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-19, to hold exactly one item for a valid id. Whether zero or multiple items are possible (e.g. for a nonexistent id) is UNCONFIRMED — not yet tested.

examples.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-19 — the real captured response from GET /products/{id}, matching fixtures/product-by-id.json byte for byte. No redaction; product catalog data has no PII.

money.title: Money
money.description: Monetary amount. Squarespace returns the value as a decimal string, not a number. Duplicated from list-products.schema.json's identical $def.

image.title: ProductImage
image.description: Confirmed against fixtures/products.json. Duplicated from list-products.schema.json's identical $def.

altText.description: Empty string when unset, not null.

availableFormats.description: Available resized widths, e.g. "100w". Can be empty.

variant.title: ProductVariant
variant.description: Confirmed against fixtures/products.json (18 variants across 4 products). Duplicated from list-products.schema.json's identical $def.

attributes.description: Keys correspond to the product's variantAttributes, e.g. { "Size": "Small" }.

shippingMeasurements.description: Confirmed against fixtures/products.json. All-zero weight/dimensions observed on every sampled variant — plausible defaults rather than confirmed non-zero behavior.

image.description: UNVERIFIED when non-null — every variant captured in fixtures/products.json has image: null. Presumably a per-variant override of the product's images[], shape unconfirmed.

product.title: Product
product.description: Confirmed against fixtures/products.json, a real GET /products response (4 products, all type PHYSICAL), and now ALSO confirmed via get_product itself, 2026-08-19, against a real GET /products/{id} response (fixtures/product-by-id.json) — the object shape matches exactly. See this schema's top-level VERIFICATION STATUS for what's confirmed about the surrounding envelope.

type.description: PHYSICAL confirmed against fixtures/products.json. DIGITAL/SERVICE/GIFT_CARD are modelled from Squarespace's product types and not yet verified against a live response.

seoOptions.description: null observed on one product, { title: "", description: "" } on two others — both confirmed shapes.

pricing.description: UNVERIFIED when non-null — null on every captured product (all 4 have per-variant pricing instead). Presumably populated for products without variants; shape unconfirmed.

digitalGood.description: UNVERIFIED when non-null — null on every captured product (all 4 are type PHYSICAL). Presumably populated for type: DIGITAL; shape unconfirmed.
